title: Buer shows particle charging depends on dynamics, not size
place_text: NASA electrostatics lab, Kennedy Space Center

tellings.quote: I was the first to show it has nothing to do with size. It has to do with dynamics.

plain: How much electric charge a particle picks up depends on how it moves and collides, not on how big it is. That is what Charles Buhler, who worked in NASA's electrostatics lab at Kennedy Space Center, tells Michels, saying he was "the first to show it has nothing to do with size. It has to do with dynamics." He offers it as his own finding from that lab work, and it is part of the background for his later claims about thrust from static electricity.
